Paint Adhesion (Cross-Cut) Test Report 6 checkpoints across 3 sections.After paint application and drying; adhesion testing mandatory for critical areas Download ExcelDownload PDF **6** Checkpoints **3** Sections Minimum 3 test areas per project; per 500m² for large areas QC Engineer, Painting Contractor [IS 101:2005](https://infralens.in/code/IS-101-Part-1-Sec-1-1986) [ASTM D3359:2017](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3359-2017) Related [📐IS 101](https://infralens.in/code/IS-101) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Paint & Coating Coverage Ra…](https://infralens.in/handbook/paint-coverage) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. TEST PROCEDURE | | A1 | Cross-cut adhesion test per IS 101/ASTM D3359; grid pattern 11 parallel lines each direction (1mm spacing)
Acceptance: Grid spacing 1mm nominal; cuts through paint to substrate; tape applied and pulled at 45 degrees | Cl. 401 — Test method | | | B. TEST RESULTS & CLASSIFICATION | | B1 | Test area 1: Paint adhesion rating 0-5 (0=no adhesion, 5=complete adhesion); rating assigned
Acceptance: Rating 5: No paint removal; 4: <5% removal; 3: 5-15% removal; 2: 15-35%; 1: >35%; 0: total failure | Cl. 401 — Individual test result | | | B2 | Test area 2: Paint adhesion rating recorded; pattern of failure documented
Acceptance: Expected ≥4 (acceptable) or ≥3 (marginal); <3 indicates adhesion failure | Cl. 401 — Individual test result | | | B3 | Test area 3: Paint adhesion rating recorded; consistency with previous areas noted
Acceptance: Ratings should be consistent; large variation indicates application or surface prep issue | Cl. 401 — Consistency check | | | C. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA | | C1 | Adhesion rating ≥4 (best practice) or ≥3 (minimum acceptable) for all test areas
Acceptance: Rating 5 or 4 = PASS; rating 3 = conditional PASS; rating <3 = FAIL; re-application required | Cl. 401 — Adhesion acceptance | | | C2 | Failure pattern analysis: Cohesive (within paint) = OK; adhesive (at interface) = problem
Acceptance: Cohesive failure indicates paint quality issue; adhesive indicates surface prep or primer issue | Cl. 401 — Failure mode assessment | | A. TEST PROCEDURE A1Cross-cut adhesion test per IS 101/ASTM D3359; grid pattern 11 parallel lines each direction (1mm spacing) Cl. 401 — Test method (IS 101) ✓ Grid spacing 1mm nominal; cuts through paint to substrate; tape applied and pulled at 45 degrees B. TEST RESULTS & CLASSIFICATION B1Test area 1: Paint adhesion rating 0-5 (0=no adhesion, 5=complete adhesion); rating assigned Cl. 401 — Individual test result (ASTM D3359) ✓ Rating 5: No paint removal; 4: <5% removal; 3: 5-15% removal; 2: 15-35%; 1: >35%; 0: total failure B2Test area 2: Paint adhesion rating recorded; pattern of failure documented Cl. 401 — Individual test result (ASTM D3359) ✓ Expected ≥4 (acceptable) or ≥3 (marginal); <3 indicates adhesion failure B3Test area 3: Paint adhesion rating recorded; consistency with previous areas noted Cl. 401 — Consistency check (ASTM D3359) ✓ Ratings should be consistent; large variation indicates application or surface prep issue C. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA C1Adhesion rating ≥4 (best practice) or ≥3 (minimum acceptable) for all test areas Cl. 401 — Adhesion acceptance (IS 2395) ✓ Rating 5 or 4 = PASS; rating 3 = conditional PASS; rating <3 = FAIL; re-application required C2Failure pattern analysis: Cohesive (within paint) = OK; adhesive (at interface) = problem Cl. 401 — Failure mode assessment (IS 101) ✓ Cohesive failure indicates paint quality issue;
